# 校园手帐封面

资源：`campus-court.jpg`。由 imagegen 内置工具生成，仅作为校园球场氛围图，不代表用户所在学校或实拍地点。原生成图保留，发布文件仅做 JPEG 编码压缩。

## 最终提示词

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Website asset for a Chinese university student's personal study and fitness journal. A quiet candid analog-film photograph of an EMPTY outdoor university basketball court in warm late-afternoon autumn sunlight. A real modest campus environment, a worn basketball hoop, faded concrete and painted court lines, mature trees and a small distant academic building. Cinematic but completely ordinary human campus life, restrained warm colors, soft film grain, gentle shadows, authentic 35mm photography. Wide landscape composition, the hoop toward the right half and generous open court space toward the left; fits a small cropped photo in a tactile paper journal, NOT a polished advertising campaign, no people, no basketball player, no floating objects, no text, no words, no watermark, no frame, no UI, no collage. Output landscape about 3:2.
